m: व्रुड् cl. 6. P. -व्रुडति, to cover, Dhātup. xxviii, 99; to heap, ib.; to sink, ib.
a: व्रुड् — {c6c} P. (व्रुडति) 1 To cover. --2 To be heaped or gathered. --3 To heap, accumulate. --4 To sink, go down.

s: Si saMvftisaMhatyoH । majje । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (tudA॰-kuwA॰-para॰-saka॰-akaYca-sew .) rePayuktaH । Si, vruqati avruqIt vuvroqa । majjo majjanam । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: saMvaraRe saka॰ saMvAte majjane ca aka॰ cu॰ kuwA॰ । para॰ sew । vruqati avruqIt ।

m: व्रुडित mfn. plunged in, immersed, sunk, Rājat.
gone astray, lost (in a thicket), ib.
